content_json.usage:
만 12세 이상 소아와 성인은 1회 1캡슐씩, 1일 2회 복용합니다.
정해진 용법·용량을 지키세요.
content_json.caution:
다음 분은 복용하지 마세요: 이 약에 과민증이 있는 환자, 만 12개월 미만 젖먹이, 심한 신부전 환자, 대두유 과민증 또는 알레르기 경험자, 콩 또는 땅콩에 과민증이 있는 환자.

복용 전 약사와 상의하세요: 치료를 받고 있는 환자, 임신 중이거나 임신 가능성이 있는 여성 및 수유부, 미숙아·유아, 심장·순환기 장애, 신장 장애, 저단백혈증 환자, 황색5호(선셋옐로우 FCF) 과민자. 고지단백혈증·당뇨병성 고지질혈증·췌장염 등 지방대사 이상 환자는 신중히 복용하세요.

인산염·칼슘염 제제, 경구용 테트라사이클린계 제제, 제산제, 레보도파와 함께 복용하지 마세요. 항알도스테론제·트리암테렌과 함께 복용하면 고칼륨혈증이 생길 수 있으니 주의하고, 녹차·홍차 등 탄닌이 든 차는 복용 전후로 피하세요.

복용 후 위부 불쾌감, 설사·변비, 구역·구토, 발진·발적 등이 나타나면 복용을 중지하고 약사와 상의하세요.

이 약은 연질캡슐로 대두유 등이 들어 있어 콩·땅콩 알레르기가 있으면 주의가 필요합니다. 매장의 약사에게 성분과 함량을 확인하세요.
증상이 지속되면 매장 내 약사 등 전문가와 상담하세요.

en.title: Mg-On Plus Soft Capsule
en.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine to supplement vitamins E, B1 and B6 during physical fatigue, pregnancy and breastfeeding, and reduced strength in old age, and to relieve peripheral circulation problems and menopausal shoulder and neck stiffness, tingling and coldness of the hands and feet, beriberi, eye strain, neuralgia, muscle and joint pain (low back pain, shoulder stiffness), inflammation of the corners of the mouth, lips, mouth and tongue, eczema and dermatitis, and muscle cramps due to magnesium deficiency.
en.usage: Children aged 12 and over and adults take 1 capsule at a time, 2 times a day. Keep to the stated dose.
en.caution: Do not take this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, are an infant under 12 months, have severe kidney failure, or have had hypersensitivity or an allergic reaction to soybean oil or an allergy to soy or peanuts. Consult a pharmacist before use if you are under medical care, are pregnant or may be pregnant or are breastfeeding, are a premature baby or infant, or have heart or circulatory disorders, kidney impairment, low blood protein, or hypersensitivity to the colorant Sunset Yellow FCF. Take with caution if you have a fat-metabolism disorder such as high blood protein, diabetic hyperlipidemia, or pancreatitis. Do not take it together with phosphate or calcium products, oral tetracycline antibiotics, antacids, or levodopa. Be careful with antialdosterone agents or triamterene as they may raise blood potassium, and avoid tannin-containing drinks such as green tea and black tea before and after taking it. Stop taking it and consult a pharmacist if you notice stomach discomfort, diarrhea or constipation, nausea or vomiting, or rash.

summaryTable.Why this one: Supplies vitamins E and B with magnesium to help fatigue, circulation and muscle symptoms together

content_json.efficacy: 육체피로, 임신·수유기, 병중·병후 체력 저하, 발육기, 노년기의 비타민 A·D·E·B1·B2·B6·C 보급과 눈의 건조감 완화, 야맹증, 뼈·치아 발육 불량·구루병 예방, 각기, 눈의 피로, 신경통·근육통·관절통(요통·어깨결림 등), 구각염·구순염·구내염·설염, 습진·피부염 증상의 완화, 아연 보급에 사용하는 일반의약품입니다.

content_json.caution:
경고: 비타민 A를 1일 5,000 IU 이상 복용하면 선천성 기형을 일으킬 수 있습니다. 임신 3개월 이내이거나 임신 가능성이 있는 여성은 복용하지 마세요. 보조요법 용량은 1일 5,000 IU를 넘지 마세요.

en.title: Exeramin Ace Tablet
en.efficacy: An over-the-counter multivitamin to supplement vitamins A, D, E, B1, B2, B6 and C and zinc during physical fatigue, pregnancy and breastfeeding, reduced strength during or after illness, growth periods and old age, and to relieve dry eyes and night blindness, prevent poor bone and tooth development and rickets, and relieve beriberi, eye strain, neuralgia, muscle and joint pain, inflammation of the corners of the mouth, lips, mouth and tongue, eczema and dermatitis.
en.usage: Ages 12 and over and adults take 1 to 2 tablets at a time, once a day. Keep to the stated dose. If symptoms do not improve after about a month, stop taking it and consult a pharmacist.
en.caution: Warning: taking 5,000 IU or more of vitamin A per day may cause birth defects. Women within the first 3 months of pregnancy or who may be pregnant must not take this medicine, and the supplementary dose should not exceed 5,000 IU of vitamin A per day. Do not take this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, have high blood calcium, sarcoidosis, kidney disease, kidney stones or severe kidney failure, are an infant under 12 months, or have a hereditary problem such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption. Consult a pharmacist before use if you have high urinary oxalate, are pregnant or may be pregnant or are breastfeeding, are a premature baby or infant, have a stomach disorder such as peptic ulcer or ulcerative colitis, or have heart or circulatory disorders, kidney impairment, low blood protein, gout, or a history of kidney stones. Do not take it together with phosphate or calcium products, oral tetracycline antibiotics, antacids, or levodopa. Consult a pharmacist if you take estrogen-containing oral contraceptives, antialdosterone agents, or triamterene, and avoid tannin-containing drinks such as green tea and black tea before and after taking it. Stop taking it and consult a pharmacist if you notice nausea or vomiting, itching, dry or rough skin, painful joint swelling, diarrhea or constipation, rash, hair loss, or stomach trouble. This medicine may interfere with glucose detection in urine tests and turn the urine yellow.

경고: 어린이의 손이 닿지 않는 곳에 보관하세요. 철 함유 제제는 만 6세 이하 어린이가 사고로 과량 복용하면 중독으로 사망할 수 있습니다.

다음 분은 복용하지 마세요: 이 약에 과민증이 있는 환자, 만 12개월 미만 젖먹이, 철이 간·이자에 침착하는 혈색소증·헤모시데린침착증 환자, 철결핍이 아닌 빈혈 환자.

복용 전 약사와 상의하세요: 만 1세 미만 젖먹이, 임신 중이거나 임신 가능성이 있는 여성 및 수유부, 미숙아·유아, 심장·순환기 장애, 신장 장애, 고옥살산뇨증, 소화성궤양·궤양성대장염 등 위장질환, 저단백혈증, 통풍·신장결석, 지방대사 이상 환자, 황색5호·적색40호 등 색소 과민 경험자, 폴산이 부족한 환자.

인산염·칼슘염 제제, 경구용 테트라사이클린계 제제, 제산제, 레보도파와 함께 복용하지 마세요. 항알도스테론제·트리암테렌과 함께 복용할 때는 약사와 상의하고, 녹차·홍차 등 탄닌이 든 차는 복용 전후로 피하세요.

복용 후 구역·구토, 설사, 두드러기·가려움, 광선과민반응, 복통·위통, 경련, 열 등이 나타나면 복용을 중지하고 약사와 상의하세요.

en.title: Hemoglutop Soft Capsule
en.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine for the prevention and treatment of iron-deficiency anemia, and to supplement vitamins B6 and C during physical fatigue, pregnancy and breastfeeding, and reduced strength during or after illness.
en.usage: Ages 8 and over and adults take 1 capsule at a time, once a day after a meal. Keep to the stated dose. If symptoms do not improve after about a month, stop taking it and consult a pharmacist.
en.caution: Warning: keep out of the reach of children. Iron-containing products can cause fatal poisoning if a child aged 6 or under accidentally takes an overdose. Do not take this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, are an infant under 12 months, have hemochromatosis or hemosiderosis in which iron deposits in the liver and pancreas, or have an anemia that is not due to iron deficiency. Consult a pharmacist before use if you are under 1 year of age, are pregnant or may be pregnant or are breastfeeding, are a premature baby or infant, or have heart or circulatory disorders, kidney impairment, high urinary oxalate, a stomach disorder such as peptic ulcer or ulcerative colitis, low blood protein, gout or kidney stones, a fat-metabolism disorder, hypersensitivity to colorants such as Sunset Yellow FCF or Allura Red AC, or folate deficiency. Do not take it together with phosphate or calcium products, oral tetracycline antibiotics, antacids, or levodopa. Consult a pharmacist if you take antialdosterone agents or triamterene, and avoid tannin-containing drinks such as green tea and black tea before and after taking it. Stop taking it and consult a pharmacist if you notice nausea or vomiting, diarrhea, hives or itching, photosensitivity, abdominal or stomach pain, cramps, or fever.

summaryTable.How it works: Combination of iron with vitamins B6 and C to prevent and treat iron-deficiency anemia
summaryTable.Symptoms: Iron-deficiency anemia, physical fatigue, reduced strength in pregnancy and breastfeeding
summaryTable.Why this one: Adds vitamins B6 and C to iron to prevent and treat iron-deficiency anemia
summaryTable.Who should be careful: Overdose risk in children aged 6 or under (poisoning), iron-overload conditions such as hemochromatosis, anemia not due to iron deficiency
